title: Chapter 629
text:
Han Xiao had gathered a large group of helpers, and the most important person was still E. Moss.

He had rarely returned to Floating Dragon in the past two years, only occasionally chatting with Ames. Ames had given him a high degree of trust, allowing him to do whatever he wanted outside without any suspicion.

The spaceship landed at the dock, and Han Xiao walked out of the cabin door. Wilsander was waiting outside to welcome him. Every time Han Xiao returned, he would see him and was extremely enthusiastic.

Looking around, Han Xiao did not see Jenny. He was a little surprised.

"Why isn't Jenny here? I thought she would shoot me a few times."

"… She's very busy." Wilsander grinned.

"Seems like she's still very dedicated."

Han Xiao laughed.

Wilsander rolled his eyes. She's dedicated because you forced her to do so.

After greeting him, Han Xiao went straight to the palace.

Ames had been holed up in Floating Dragon for the past two years, focusing on training Hella and her sister. When they heard that Han Xiao was visiting, the three of them were quite happy.

Ames got up and left her throne, floating to Han Xiao with a smile. "I haven't seen you in a while, and I miss you a little. Why are you looking for me?"

"Can't I come back to visit if there's nothing?" Han Xiao smiled. "But I do need your help this time."

"Speak."

Han Xiao explained. It was not that he wanted Ames to deal with Shana and the other two, as it would not be easy to let them go. What he needed was for Ames to hold the line when attacking the enemy's base to ensure a hundred percent success rate.

At the same time, this was also an opportunity for him. He had gathered many reputable organizations in the Shattered Star Ring and gathered them in a secret place. After he defeated Shana and the other two, he would join forces to attack the base camp of this mysterious organization and save the experts of the various organizations. With so many organizations gathered, if Ames were to hold the fort, she could temporarily lead these organizations as a Beyond Grade A Super.

Han Xiao had called in so many forces. Dealing with six A-class powerhouses was like killing a chicken with a butcher's knife. His bigger goal was to make this a sensational news and expand his influence.

With so many large organizations working together with Floating Dragon as the leader, it would be able to change the impression that many people had of Floating Dragon. Floating Dragon would go from being a neutral organization that stood aloof from worldly affairs to a powerful faction. Even if it was a misunderstanding, it would still be useful.

All along, among the four Beyond Grade As in the Shattered Star Ring, Ames's organization was publicly acknowledged to be the weakest. This time, she was able to refresh her knowledge, which was very beneficial.

His raw strength could not be increased quickly, but influence and connections were a shortcut. The stronger Floating Dragon was, the more it could help him.

Furthermore, after fighting side by side, if he saved the people of these organizations, they would have to owe him a favor and form a good relationship with them in the name of Floating Dragon. Although these organizations had status, they would obviously give face to the Beyond Grade As. Through Floating Dragon, he would be able to turn these organizations into his own connections.

After all, the universe was so big, and one person's strength was limited. Even a Beyond Grade A would need helpers. Both individual combat strength and the size of his organization had to be grasped.

The version update would come sooner or later, and the players would disappear for about ten years. If he wanted to ensure that his faction did not shrink or even grow stronger, he would need more external support.

After hearing Han Xiao's explanation, Ames did not hesitate and agreed.

She supported Han Xiao one hundred percent. Furthermore, she had been cooped up for so long, and she did want to go out and exercise. She wanted Hella and Aurora to go out and experience the world.

Han Xiao looked to the side. Hella and Aurora did not say anything. After two years of training, their temperament had changed.

Ames taught the two of them how to develop their Esper Abilities. Hella's aura became colder and colder, while Aurora's aura became warmer and warmer.

In terms of strength, Hella improved rapidly. She originally had Grade C strength, and her talent was very strong. After being developed by Ames, she did not take any detours and had officially stepped into Grade B.

Aurora's position was a super healer. Although her Grade was not high, her abilities had become much stronger.

Hella's appearance did not change much, but after her Life Evolution, she became taller and more beautiful. Aurora's height did not grow much, but her figure became that of a real 'healer'. Her combat uniform was bulging.

Her Esper Ability gave her a terrifying amount of vitality. Coupled with the three nutritious meals a day, her size was not much worse than her sister's.

Han Xiao looked at Aurora's chest and sighed. "Your training is too tough. Look, such a good girl, but her breasts are all swollen."

Aurora could tell that Han Xiao was joking, and her face instantly turned red. She did not want to grow so big, but this was an ability that came with her Esper Ability. She had no choice. Her shoulders were sore from shaking every day, and it would be great if she could take it off and put it in her pocket.

After not seeing each other for two years, although Hella was expressionless, she was actually a little excited. However, when she heard that, her face instantly darkened. She did not say a word and looked at Han Xiao's face with a gaze as sharp as a knife. In the end, she was unable to move an inch and was directly ignored by Han Xiao.

Han Xiao then brought up the issue of Section Zero and said that he would work for the Amethyst Civilization for a period of time. Ames did not have any objections and was very happy to be a hands-off boss.

…

Han Xiao secretly gathered his helpers. After he was done with his preparations, he found an unimportant Black Star base and stayed there, waiting for the enemy to step into his trap.

This base was located on one of Godora's colonial planets, and many players would often settle down there. Choosing this place as the battlefield was a decision that Han Xiao had made after much consideration. At the same time, it was also to improve his image in front of the players.

Now that the Black Star Corps had completed the function of guiding factions, Han Xiao's next goal was to keep the players around so that the Black Star Corps would always be the main faction.

In the next version, the number of factions that could be chosen would increase exponentially. Many of them would be allied forces with high benefits and a large-scale main storyline. The players would be tempted, and Han Xiao had to maintain the attractiveness of his faction. As the leader of the faction, he had to continuously increase the players' impression of him.

After waiting for a few days, Shana and the other two finally made their move. In fact, they had arrived at the Garton Star System long ago and had been observing Han Xiao's movements.

Han Xiao had also been observing them. The second round of the [Prey] mission popped up.

The requirement was to repel the attack of three people. Other than the high EXP reward, he could also randomly draw an ability from Eliot and the other two. Han Xiao guessed that in this series of high-difficulty missions, there might be a special reward for drawing an ability in each round. As long as he was lucky, he could earn a lot.

As this was a colonial planet of Godora, Shana and the other two did not want to make too much noise. They still decided to use stealth tactics and close range attacks to finish off Black Star quickly before retreating.

Eliot used his high-level concealment and disguise skills. Although the base had access control, it was useless in front of a Grade A Master. Without alerting Philip, he and Adrian easily sneaked into the base. Shana was waiting outside to meet them.

The camouflage spell allowed the two of them to take on the appearance of common mercenaries. Eliot was very confident in his spells and thought that they would not be seen through. The two of them swaggered around as if they were strolling in their own backyard.

However, after walking for a while, the two of them realized that something was wrong. Everywhere they passed, almost all the Black Star mercenaries would look at them with strange expressions, as if the two of them did not fit in.

"I feel that something is wrong," Adrian whispered.

"Have we been discovered? Impossible, how could my spells be seen through by so many people? "

Eliot could not believe it.

His disguise spells were actually effective. At least the surrounding players could not see any information about them. Even their names were question marks.

However, the question marks on the two men's faces were bright red!

Two red-named enemies were walking around in their home. The players were shocked and did not know what was going on.

Although Brock was a Dark-star member, he was still a spy. Dark-star had already passed away. Before he joined Black Star, he was only a yellow name. However, Eliot and Adrian were enemies. Red names were simply the most beautiful scenery in the eyes of the players.

Bang bang bang!

A player suddenly fired at the two of them. The surrounding players followed suit. The bullet screen covered the two of them and there was a violent explosion.

Although they did not know what was going on, they were both red names anyway. There might be a mission to trigger, so it was definitely worth it to be reckless.

Buzz!

The magic shield opened up and blocked all the attacks.

"We've been exposed!"

Eliot was shocked. He couldn't understand how all these C-grade mercenaries were able to see through his flawless disguise.

At this time, Han Xiao, who had been prepared, immediately appeared. He floated in the air and looked down at the two of them. He put on his acting skills and pretended that he did not know where they came from.

"When I was attacked last time, I felt that something was wrong. Sure enough, someone was targeting me. Who are you people?"

Eliot didn't answer. He let out a deep roar and unleashed all kinds of spells. Adrian's aura surged even higher.

Outside, Shauna knew that her teammates had been exposed. She immediately took action and tore apart the outer wall of the base, preparing to surround and attack Han Xiao. Although the infiltration had failed, they had three Grade A + Supers. They could definitely crush Black Star in a head-on battle. They could still end the battle quickly.

Han Xiao easily avoided the attack and said, "Do you think I'm not prepared?"

As soon as he said that, several auras exploded around the base. Nagojin and the other two Godora Grade A Executive Officers came out from their hiding places.

The forces Han Xiao gathered were prepared to attack the enemy's base. His goal was only to force Shauna and the other two to retreat. He purposely chose Godora's colonial planet as the battlefield because he had reached an agreement with Godora. If he asked them for help, their strength would not be too overwhelming. They could naturally let Shauna and the other two 'escape' successfully.

The Black Star Corps had deep cooperation with Godora. This small request was just a phone call from Han Xiao. Nagojin was more than willing to help.

Eliot frowned. Their opponents were four Grade A Supers. The three of them were not afraid, but they could not end the battle quickly. This was Godora's colonial planet. If they were delayed, Godora's fleet could cause them a lot of trouble.

The three of them looked at each other and came to a consensus.

Black Star was too vigilant. They had only been ambushed once. Without knowing their background, he did not hesitate to make a mountain out of a molehill to lure them out. In their eyes, he was very cautious and decisive.

The three of them did not suspect that their whereabouts had been exposed. Han Xiao pretended to be stupid and did not arouse their suspicions. They were confident that their movements were very secretive.

Furthermore, if Black Star knew that the three of them were coming together, he would not have just ambushed three Calamity Grade Supers.

Han Xiao continued his act and said with a deep voice, "You have nowhere to run. No matter who you are, I will force you to tell me your origins."

"You're too confident. If you can stop us, you can try."

Eliot snorted.

Four Calamity Grade Supers were nothing in his eyes. Perhaps Black Star was the only one who was difficult to deal with.
